answer: Because the delta collateral is checked against the walnut claim at intake, the ivory audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases as a result has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Posted collateral must equal 4 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 37 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
